Connected fleet; Self-testing cloud; Agent operations desk; OTA release train; Agent-to-agent API; Live telemetry; Knowledge copilot; Event-driven store; Clinic booking; Multi-tenant SaaS; Solar microgrid; Farm autopilot; Inbox to ERP; Shipment radar; Research swarm; Edge vision; Zero-trust access; Data lake and SQL agent; Offline-first mobile; Agent evals and tracing.

g.text: Devices report state in real time; phones and agents read it and send commands back.
Agents break the system on a schedule, measure the fall, and page a human before users notice.
An AI agent signs in like a teammate and runs internal tools with the same permissions as people.
Signed firmware moves from CI to the fleet in waves, with health checks and rollback at every step.
One company's agent negotiates with another's through a typed API and a tool manifest.
Sensor streams turned into live dashboards and alerts within seconds.
Company documents become a private assistant that answers with sources.
Orders fan out as events: payment, stock, shipping, and email each react on their own.
Patients book, pay, and get reminders; each clinic sees only its own data.
Containerized services that scale per tenant, with isolated data and zero-downtime deploys.
Inverters and meters report every minute; a model forecasts demand and balances the batteries.
Sensors and cameras watch the crop; the system adjusts light, water, and climate on its own.
Invoices arrive by email; an agent extracts the data, a human approves, and the ERP gets it.
Carrier updates stream in; the team chasing each box hears the moment it moves.
An orchestrator splits a question across parallel agents; a verifier checks every claim.
Cameras detect events on the device; only the clips that matter reach the cloud and the phone.
People and machine accounts get least-privilege access; every action lands in an audit trail.
Every app writes to one lake; an agent answers business questions in plain language.
Phones keep working offline and sync when they reconnect; every user sees changes live.
Every agent run is traced and scored, so a regression shows up before it ships.
